subject: statistics: add statsVer for HistColl (#51548)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent: it introduces `HistColl.StatsVer` and populates it during stats load paths (bootstrap/storage/json/needed-histogram loads) and simplifies analyze-version checking to use the table-level value. A High-severity candidate bug in this commit (sync-load cache update mistakenly setting `tbl.StatsVer` to `Version0` when loading analyzed hists) is fixed later on `upstream/master` (sync-load updates now set `tbl.StatsVer = int(<hist>.StatsVer)`), leaving no remaining High/Blocker issues at head-of-master.
